channel.title: The Economic Edge: Master Your Wealth

item.title: Selling stakes in the beautiful game. What could go wrong?
item.description: "Explore the high-stakes world of football club ownership in our podcast, 'Selling Stakes in the Beautiful Game. What Could Go Wrong?' Join us as we dive into the business side of the sport, discussing investments, ownership models, and the pitfalls that come with buying and selling football clubs."
